## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| All admin endpoints require admin-level authentication | authorization | User must be authenticated and have IsAdmin=true |
| Password must meet minimum length requirement for plain auth | validation | u.LoginType == auth.Plain && len(password) < setting.MinPasswordLength |
| Password must meet complexity requirements | validation | !password.IsComplexEnough(form.Password) |
| Password must not be in known breach databases (HaveIBeenPwned) | validation | password.IsPwned returns error |
| Admin-created users are active by default (overrides registration confirmation settings) | business_logic | User created via admin API |
| Email domain warning added to response header if domain conflicts with allowlist/blocklist | business_logic | !user_model.IsEmailDomainAllowed(u.Email) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Auth source ID not found | 422 | validation error | False |
| Password too short for plain auth | 400 | PasswordIsRequired | False |
| Password not complex enough | 400 | PasswordComplexity | False |
| Password found in breach database | 400 | PasswordPwned | False |
| HaveIBeenPwned API call fails | 400 | PasswordPwned | True |
| Username already taken | 422 | validation error | False |
| Email already registered | 422 | validation error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Auth source not found** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Password too short** → ctx.APIError → 400
- **Password not complex** → ctx.APIError → 400
- **Password pwned** → ctx.APIError → 400
- **User already exists** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Email already used** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **DB error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| timeout | ❌ missing | medium | HaveIBeenPwned API call uses http.DefaultClient with no timeout. Request can hang indefinitely. |
| retry | ❌ missing | low | No retry logic for transient network failures to HaveIBeenPwned |
| circuit_breaker | ❌ missing | low | No circuit breaker for HaveIBeenPwned API |
| fallback | ✅ configured | low | Fallback exists: PasswordCheckPwn config can disable the check entirely. When API fails, error is logged and user creation is rejected. |

**Cascading failure risk:** HaveIBeenPwned down → all admin user creation blocked (if PasswordCheckPwn=true)

**Graceful degradation:** Can be disabled via PasswordCheckPwn=false config
